title: Orb Island
author: Seth Morrow
description: A small 3D game made with box3dxt's b3k Kit: walk a floating island, find the eight golden orbs and do not fall off the edge. A sweeper arm turns, a wrecking ball swings, a lift rides up a tower and a jump pad throws you onto a floating platform; kick, blast and drop crates. Where the player has render3dxt it is textured and lit, and V swaps the two renderers.
